description: Fleet Engagement: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: Two battle lines will meet in {system} and {client} has asked every pilot it can pay to fly in the gap. The {flagship} leads the line. {enemy} will bring everything it has to the engagement. Fighters first, then the heavy ships. Stay alive, protect the {flagship} and kill what you can.

{client} commits its fleet to {system}. The {flagship} commands. Your job is to keep the fighters off the line and the {flagship} afloat. The {target} is the {enemy} flagship. If it dies, their line breaks.
This is the large one. Both fleets, in range, with fighters weaving between them. The {flagship} holds the centre. Kill the {target} if you can reach it.
success: The {enemy} line breaks and withdraws behind its fighters. {client} claims {system} and pays {captain} for a hard day.
The {target} burns and the {enemy} fleet loses its nerve. {client} pays and the {flagship} signals a thank you.
When the shooting stops the {flagship} is still on station. {client} pays and begins the long count of wreckage.
failure: The {flagship} is lost and the line folds. {client} withdraws from {system} under fire.
The {enemy} fleet takes the field. {client} calls it a delaying action and pays accordingly.
radio-line: All ships, this is the {flagship}. We hold the centre. Fighters, you have the space between.
{client} line, form on the {flagship}. Turrets free.
Battle line forming. {captain}, stay between us and them.
radio-enemyline: Enemy line sighted, bearing zero. They have a battlecruiser at the centre, probably the {target}.
{enemy} fleet coming into range. Fighters first, ships behind them.
Contacts. Many contacts. Pick one and shoot it.
radio-screen: Their screen is coming. Ten fighters and four bombers headed for the {flagship}.
Bombers inbound for the {flagship}. Cover it now.
Fighter screen is in. Hold them off the line.
radio-reserve: Jump flash above the plane. {enemy} carrier with an escort. It was waiting.
Reserve carrier is in. It is putting out a second wing.
Another carrier. They held it back. Brace.
radio-reinforce: Reinforcements from {client}. A cruiser and two squadrons. Hold on.
Friendly jump flash behind us. They have been late all day. They are here now.
Reserve squadrons arrived. Fly with them.
radio-breakthrough: The {target} is dying. Their remaining fighters are going for you personally.
Their command is gone. Stragglers are running. Take them down.
Enemy flagship is destroyed. Last fighters are still dangerous.
